text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: high-severity auth failures in aurora-enterprise VPC. Observed beginning 2026-03-14 01:12 UTC. Symptoms: TLS handshake failures from aurora-prod dedicated pool -> 502/503 on tenant traffic. Potential cause: mTLS cert expired on ingress LB for customer VPC. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vpc-mtls-expiry

sara (oncall): ack, I'm on it. grabbing logs and cert info now. if this is the LB cert we can short-term reissue with the backup key.

sara (oncall): quick checks:
```
# check cert expiry from within our control plane
openssl s_client -connect aurora-prod-vpc-lb.internal:443 -showcerts < /dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates
kubectl --context=private-aurora get secrets -n aurora-system | grep mTLS
```

sara (oncall): seeing cert expires: Mar 14 01:09:00 2026 GMT -> yep, expired ~3 minutes ago. customer traffic started failing at 01:11. tagging nina from CS for customer comms.

nina (cs): thanks — I'll message the customer with a short blurb. Can you confirm if there is any data plane impact beyond HTTP 5xx? they reported chat sessions dropping.

raj (infra): pinging to confirm: there are two certs for that VPC: control-plane cert (renewed automatically) and customer mTLS cert (rotated via onboarding). Looks like customer cert rotation didn't run. checking rotation job logs.

mike (eng): if rotation job failed we should consider immediate hotfix: import a pem we can sign with our intermediate (per customer SLA) and re-provision, then follow with key rotation post-incident. Do we have the customer's consent recorded?

nina (cs): customer consent is in onboarding doc X-aurora#557, they approved emergency reissue for outages in their SLA. I have that open.

sara (oncall): mitigation plan (short-term):
1) temporarily attach fallback cert (our intermediate-signed) to ingress to restore handshakes.
2) bring up a canary route to dedicated-fallback pool for traffic from a subset of tenant IP ranges.
3) run rotation job with verbose logging and watch for errors.

sara (oncall): executing step 1 now.

ops-bot: action initiated by sara (oncall): replace-ingress-cert aurora-prod-vpc --cert intermediate-signed-2026-03-14 --trace-id=trace-6b7f

sara (oncall): applied fallback cert. running healthchecks...

sara (oncall): healthchecks green for control plane -> backend TLS ok, app 200s returning for test traffic. monitoring metrics for 5xx.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-8472, severity: P1, assigned channel: #incidents, owner: sara (oncall).

nina (cs): I just told the customer we have a temporary fix in place and are performing a full rotation. They asked for ETA on full remediation.

mike (eng): ETA for full remediation (rotate keys + validate mTLS handshake across tenants) ~30-45 mins if rotation job completes. if rotation job errors we may need manual secret update per node.

raj (infra): rotation job logs show failure at 01:09 due to permission error hitting customer's KMS key ARN: AccessDenied. Looks like policy got tightened during a recent housekeeping PR.

sara (oncall): ok that explains why automatic rotation failed. mitigation step 2: rolling canary to dedicated-fallback pool is live — about 10% of traffic rerouted by IP CIDR. Observed customer error rate drop from 60% -> 12% for canaried ranges.

nina (cs): customer response: "Thanks, partial restoration is noticed. Please keep us updated."

mike (eng): I'll open a privilege escalation for the KMS policy and prepare to rotate the key with infra approval. If we cannot get KMS policy changed, we fallback to manual secret write via secure inventory and rotate per node.

raj (infra): starting KMS policy revert: submitting infra-GCP ticket and pinging security to approve temporary acl. If approved we can resume automated rotation; otherwise I'll coordinate manual secret push.

sara (oncall): current status: fallback cert applied (service restored for most traffic), canary mitigations reducing impact, root cause: customer KMS key policy prevented automated rotation -> expired mTLS cert. Next actions:
- raj to pursue KMS ACL revert or manual secret write (priority)
- mike to validate rotation job post-ACL change and run full regression tests
- nina to keep customer updated with ETA (30-45m) and note partial restoration
- sara to monitor metrics and keep channel updated; if errors rise re-run rollback plan

mike (eng): noted. I'll be on-call for the next 2 hours, please handoff to me at 02:00 UTC if still active.

ops-bot: handoff reminder set by sara (oncall) for 02:00 UTC to mike (eng).

raj (infra): update: security approved temporary acl, reverted the policy change at 01:45 UTC. retrying rotation job now.

sara (oncall): rotation job started, logs look clean. running smoke tests...

sara (oncall): smoke tests pass. doing full tenant sweep.

incident-bot: monitoring: 5xx rate back to baseline for aurora-prod at 01:59 UTC.

nina (cs): customer confirmed full service restoration at 02:05 UTC and very appreciative of fast action. shared post-incident contact.

mike (eng): I'll stay with post-rotation monitoring and follow up with postmortem doc. a couple action items: add KMS ACL alert to infra runbook, ensure rotation job has a fallback that doesn't rely on ephemeral ACLs, and add a scheduled test that validates rotation two days before expiry.

sara (oncall): handing off live ownership to mike (eng). summary for handoff:
- cause: expired mTLS cert due to rotation job failing (KMS AccessDenied after policy change)
- mitigation: applied intermediate fallback cert + canary route -> restored majority traffic, then restored automated rotation after ACL revert
- customer impact: P1 outage for customer tenant, ~54 minutes partial outage, full restore at 02:05 UTC
- next steps: postmortem + action items (KMS alert, rotation tests, runbook update)

mike (eng): taking ownership. I'll draft the postmortem and assign to raj for infra remediation. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-8472 status updated to "stabilized" by mike (eng).

sara (oncall): closing my on-call loop, leaving logs and links:
- rotation logs: https://logs.internal/aurora/INC-2026-8472/rotation.log
- runbook used: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vpc-mtls-expiry
- customer comm note: https://cs.internal/aurora/comm-2026-03-14

mike (eng): last note — classify as "process" > "privilege/config drift". postmortem target: 72h.

raj (infra): assigned remediation ticket INFRA-1229 for KMS policy guardrails and rotation job circuit-breaker.

incident-bot: incident INC-2026-8472 closed at 2026-03-14 03:12 UTC (post-stabilization monitoring).

sara (oncall): :thumbsup: good work everyone.
